message.reasoning: We need to answer using policy excerpts. The question: "Our on-call engineer flagged a brief window of total 503s and asked me to check whether that matches a known incident." So they want to know how to check if that matches a known incident. According to DOC-046 and DOC-047: status page lists every incident, including brief ones, with start/end times, component breakdown. Also brief slowdown should check status page. So answer: go to status page, look for incident with 503, check component-level breakdown. Provide guidance. Use short answer. No need to escalate. So post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"You can verify that 503 window on the status page. Meridian’s status page records every incident – even short‑lived 503 responses – with exact start and end times and shows which components were affected. Open the status page, locate any incident that lists a 503 response during the time window you saw, and use the component‑level breakdown to see if the API (or the relevant service) was impacted. If you find a matching entry, that’s the known incident your engineer flagged."}
